note: Trigger-routing suite, minted alongside feature-intake-rules (closes gh#711, lld-0024). Positives cover all four intake shapes (component/module, layout/shell, UX flow, cross-cutting UX) plus a capture-completeness check, one per shape plus adjacent-phrasing repeats. Negatives fence the four siblings this capability overlaps trigger vocabulary with: make-component, break-down-layout, break-down-flow (the BUILD asks themselves), and docs' file-feature (the general intake procedure this pack is consulted FROM, never absorbed into).

cases.prompt: what fields does a button component ticket need before we build it
what should a dashboard-shell ticket capture before we design it
what does an onboarding-flow ticket need to state to be capture-complete
is this UI ticket capture-complete or is something missing
what's missing from this component ticket before it's ready to build
what motion/focus/i18n budget should a new toast ticket state
what fields should a layout ticket capture on both the space and behavior axes

cases.note: make-component — the build itself, not the ticket's own intake fields

cases.prompt: review this dashboard layout, does the sidebar nav make sense
cases.note: break-down-layout — grading an existing layout, not what a ticket should capture

cases.prompt: wireframe a settings page for the saas-dashboard shell
cases.note: break-down-layout DESIGN mode — designing the layout itself

cases.prompt: walk the password-reset flow and check for dead ends
map the checkout flow as a state machine
can we add a dark mode toggle to settings
cases.note: docs' file-feature — a plain feature idea with no UI-shape intake question asked

cases.prompt: file a feature ticket for CSV export
cases.note: docs' file-feature — general intake, not a UI-shaped schema ask
